note: Public offset alerts shown on the website: a weekly round-up of new defence sales above the offset thresholds. This file is the permanent record: never delete an item. The site shows only items whose 'added' date is within the last three weeks of 'updated' (at least eight items are always shown), so older items fall away from the pages but stay here. 'date' is when the event happened (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM if only the month is known); 'added' is the date the item went on the site; 'tag' is optional ('Civil' or 'Rules'). Summaries are Capital's own words: one or two plain factual lines, with a short note on offset only where it is clear (for example, no offset because a purchase is SAFE-funded). Sources are not shown on the site and are not kept in this public file; they are recorded privately in the 'Website alerts: sources (private)' table of the Offset Opportunity Monitor's Programme Register (a Claude Doc). Internal scores, suggested services and verdicts from the Offset Opportunity Monitor never go here.

items.title: Israel signs for 12 AH-64E Apache helicopters worth about US$1bn
items.summary: Israel's Ministry of Defense has signed an agreement with the Pentagon to buy 12 Boeing AH-64E Apache attack helicopters, worth about US$1 billion, with deliveries due early next decade. The government moved NIS 1 billion into the defence budget to pay for the deal.

items.title: Bulgaria approves a deal with Germany for five more IRIS-T SLM air defence systems
items.summary: Bulgaria's Council of Ministers has approved a draft programme agreement with Germany for five more IRIS-T SLM surface-to-air missile systems from Diehl Defence, funded under the EU's SAFE defence loans. The agreement still needs ratification by the National Assembly.

items.title: Greece asks the US to sell it Saronic Corsair uncrewed surface vessels
items.summary: Greece has sent the US a Letter of Request to buy Corsair uncrewed surface vessels from Saronic through Foreign Military Sales, after Hellenic Navy trials. The ministry did not give a number; Greek press reports a plan for at least 30 boats.

items.title: Sweden signs contracts to train Polish submarine crews and lease Poland a submarine
items.summary: Sweden's procurement agency FMV and the Swedish Navy have signed contracts under Poland's Orka programme to train Polish crews and lease HMS Södermanland to Poland until new boats arrive. They build on Poland's agreement for three Saab A26 submarines, the first due in 2031.

items.title: Kuwait buys a £370m British air defence system from MARSS
items.summary: Kuwait is buying an integrated air defence system of jammers, radars and interceptors, built around MARSS's NiDAR command and control centre, in a £370 million deal the UK government says will create 100 UK jobs. Kuwait's offset programme has been suspended since 2015, so no offset applies.

items.title: Greece agrees about US$4bn of US deals, including 37 more F-16 Block 70 upgrades
items.summary: During the US Secretary of State's visit to Athens, Greece agreed to about US$4 billion of US weapons and equipment: about US$1 billion to upgrade 37 F-16 Block 50 jets to Block 70, US$1.2 billion of air weapons and US$750 million of MH-60 helicopter support.

items.title: US approves a possible US$1.04bn sale of APKWS-II guidance sections to the UAE
items.summary: The US State Department has approved a possible sale to the United Arab Emirates of up to 10,000 APKWS-II laser guidance sections and related equipment, estimated at US$1.041 billion.

items.title: Belgium buys 10 NASAMS air defence firing units from Kongsberg for about €918m
items.summary: Kongsberg has signed a contract worth NOK 10 billion (about €918 million) with the Dutch procurement agency, acting for Belgium, for 10 NASAMS firing units. They are part of a Belgian air defence package of about €3.1 billion.

items.title: Thailand picks Hanwha Ocean to build its next frigate, with a THB 7.25bn offset package
items.summary: The Royal Thai Navy has selected Hanwha Ocean to build a 4,000-tonne frigate for THB 16.73 billion. The offset package is worth about THB 7.25 billion (43% of the project), with at least 20% of the ship's structure built in Thailand and transfer of designs and combat-system know-how.

items.title: South Korea approves a US$2.4bn purchase of 20 more MH-60R Seahawk helicopters
items.summary: South Korea's Defense Acquisition Program Administration has approved buying about 20 more Lockheed Martin MH-60R Seahawk helicopters for KRW 3.24 trillion (about US$2.4 billion), to be acquired through 2032.

items.title: Croatia signs €435m contracts for 18 K239 Chunmoo rocket launchers
items.summary: Croatia has signed contracts worth €435.2 million (excluding VAT) with Hanwha Aerospace for 18 K239 Chunmoo multiple rocket launchers with ammunition and training, plus a command system from Poland's WB Electronics. The defence minister said Croatian firms, including Končar, will take part.

items.title: Peru moves to fund a second batch of 12 F-16 Block 70 fighters
items.summary: Peru's government has asked Congress for extra funding to buy a second batch of 12 F-16 Block 70 fighters from Lockheed Martin, which would take its fleet to 24. In August, Lockheed Martin announced a US$1.8 billion industrial and social collaboration package for Peru's F-16 programme.

items.title: Romania orders 12 Airbus H225M helicopters under the EU's SAFE defence loans
items.summary: Airbus has announced an order from Romania for 12 H225M helicopters, placed through France's armaments agency and paid for with the EU's SAFE defence loans, with Romania's IAR as Airbus's long-term partner. SAFE-funded purchases are exempt from Romania's offset rules, so this order carries no Romanian offset.

items.title: Colombian Army opens a US$34.5m tender for light transport aircraft
items.summary: The Colombian Army has opened a tender worth about US$34.5 million for two light transport aircraft to replace three retired C-212s, with offers due on 26 October. The Czech-built L-410 NG is seen as the leading candidate.

items.title: Seven fighter types in the running to replace Austria's early Eurofighters
items.summary: Seven fighter types, including Boeing's F-15EX, are reported to be in the running to replace the Austrian Air Force's Tranche 1 Eurofighters.

items.title: Malaysia's Budget 2027 includes 42 new trains and a RM3.4bn rail overhaul
items.summary: Presenting Budget 2027, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said the government will buy 42 new train sets for the ETS and KTM Komuter services, and that Prasarana will invest more than RM3.4 billion to rehabilitate its rail services.

items.title: India's Air Force seeks proposals for 60 medium transport aircraft
items.summary: The Indian Air Force's request for proposals for 60 medium transport aircraft, to replace its An-32 and Il-76 fleets, has responses due in December and asks for at least 40% Indian content. Embraer with Mahindra (C-390) and Lockheed Martin with Tata (C-130J-30) are the main bidders.

items.title: Denmark takes delivery of the first of four new air defence systems
items.summary: Denmark's defence procurement agency has received the first of four new ground-based air defence systems, a NASAMS, from a DKK 58.2 billion programme. Contracts for support equipment are still to be signed.

items.title: Greece signs for two Italian FREMM frigates, with work for Greek industry
items.summary: Greece and Italy have signed the arrangement transferring the frigates Carlo Bergamini and Virginio Fasan to the Hellenic Navy in 2028 and 2029, with Greek industry taking part in their maintenance and in integrating new systems.

items.title: Malaysia's offset cap on CPTPP-covered purchases drops from 60% to 40% on 29 November
items.summary: Under Malaysia's schedule to the CPTPP trade pact, offset credits on purchases by the covered ministries are capped at 60% of contract value until 28 November 2026, then 40% until 2030 and 20% until 2034, with none after that.

items.title: Still no government response on the UK's defence offsets consultation
items.summary: The Ministry of Defence's written consultation on a possible UK defence offsets policy closed on 23 December 2025, and as of 13 October 2026 no outcome has been published.

items.title: Canada takes next step with Saab on GlobalEye early-warning aircraft
items.summary: Canada has signed a non-binding term sheet with Saab, its preferred supplier, ahead of negotiations to buy six GlobalEye airborne early warning and control aircraft. The government says it is working with Saab to maximise benefits for Canada through its Industrial and Technological Benefits (ITB) policy.

items.title: US approves possible sale of 21 Black Hawk helicopters to Norway
items.summary: The US has notified a possible sale of 21 UH-60M Black Hawk helicopters to Norway, valued at about US$2.3 billion.

items.title: Boeing signs Apache offset agreements with Polish industry
items.summary: Boeing has signed offset agreements with the Polish companies WZL-1 and WCBKT covering training and sustainment for Poland's AH-64E Apache fleet.

items.title: US approves possible APKWS II laser-guided rocket sale to Saudi Arabia
items.summary: A possible sale of APKWS II laser guidance kits to Saudi Arabia, valued at about US$1.96 billion, has been notified to the US Congress. The US notice says the purchaser typically requests offsets.

items.title: US approves possible sale of 155mm artillery shells to Norway
items.summary: A possible sale of 155mm M795 high-explosive shells to Norway, valued at about US$270 million, has been notified.

items.title: TKMS chosen as preferred bidder for Canada's new submarines
items.summary: Canada has selected Germany's TKMS as preferred bidder for up to 12 Type 212CD submarines under the Canadian Patrol Submarine Project. Contract negotiations, including industrial benefits for Canada, now follow.

items.title: Swiss F-35A offset programme expected to exceed its targets
items.summary: The Swiss government reports further offset projects placed with Swiss industry under the F-35A purchase, and expects the agreed offset targets to be clearly exceeded.

items.title: Canada and Australia partner on Arctic over-the-horizon radar
items.summary: Canada has agreed a partnership with Australia to deliver the Arctic Over-the-Horizon Radar, part of its plan to modernise NORAD, and has signed an Industrial and Technological Benefits agreement with BAE Systems Australia.

items.title: Swiss Parliament approves Armaments Programme 2026, with more IRIS-T SLM air defence
items.summary: The Swiss Parliament approved the Armaments Programme 2026 on 15 September, including additional IRIS-T SLM ground-based air defence systems.
